description: Output is sanitized once: invalid UTF-8, terminal escapes, CR and DEL become \xNN, Unicode Cc/Cf become \u{HEX}, TAB and LF and printable text stay. stderr and stdout share the capture file. Output without a final newline leaves the status line on its last line.
